purpose: Close monitor-only orchestration gaps by requiring deterministic continuation whenever a materially observed state admits a bounded authorized next action.
invariants: HOLD only for an explicit deterministic blocker or authority boundary
scope: Repository-native orchestration, monitoring, review continuation, materialization continuation, issue work-unit continuation, compiler/TEMDD continuation, publication preparation, and role-local Authority/Mirror workflows.
exclusions: No independent review authority is created.
No merge, publication, deployment, credential use, external effect, PASS, FINAL_PASS, or EFFECT_ACK_DONE is implied.
A terminal watcher may report a human or owner boundary but must not fabricate crossing it.
